Source: step 3 of the parent-supplied proof of dgcr_graph_integer_density_on_graph ('μ is carried by Σ inside C': for Borel S, μ(S) = ∫⁻_{M∩S} θ dHⁿ ≥ Hⁿ(M ∩ S), applied with S := (spt μ)ᶜ to get Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ) = 0). In the grandparent proof this is step 9 ('since θ ≥ 1 on M'), a detail behind 'Hence by Allard's Theorem 5.2 of Ch. 5 we have y ∈ reg T' in Simon 7.4.3 (chapter-07.txt lines 624–631), with μ_T = θHⁿ⌞M as in Simon Ch. 6, 3.1. The argument is copied and specialized; nothing new is introduced.
Notation: Hⁿ := μHE[n]; M := R.carrier; θ := R.mult; μ := R.measure, which by the frozen definition IMRep.measure is (Hⁿ.restrict M).withDensity (fun x => (θ x : ℝ≥0∞)); spt μ := μ.support.
Formalization note: unless this child is split further it is a machine leaf: one theorem appended to the frozen GMT/Ch07/Submission.lean (inside `namespace Submission`), with no new import and no helper declaration. It uses no sibling or uncle declaration; every lemma cited below is in the import closure of GMT.Ch07.Submission (Mathlib 25730c7c, simongmt 2b36630, project b4d606d).
1. Key inequality: Hⁿ(S ∩ M) ≤ μ(S) for every Borel set S ⊆ ℝ^P. Indeed, unfold IMRep.measure. Since S is measurable, withDensity_apply gives μ(S) = ∫⁻_{x ∈ S} θ(x) d(Hⁿ⌞M)(x), and Measure.restrict_restrict (S measurable) rewrites (Hⁿ⌞M)⌞S = Hⁿ⌞(S ∩ M), so μ(S) = ∫⁻_{S∩M} θ dHⁿ. Also Hⁿ(S ∩ M) = ∫⁻_{S∩M} 1 dHⁿ (setLIntegral_one). The set S ∩ M is Borel (M is Borel by R.measurableSet_carrier), and for x ∈ S ∩ M we have 0 < θ(x) by R.mult_pos; as θ(x) is a natural number this gives 1 ≤ θ(x) in [0, ∞] (a cast of 1 ≤ θ(x) in ℕ). Hence setLIntegral_mono' (pointwise on the measurable set S ∩ M) gives ∫⁻_{S∩M} 1 dHⁿ ≤ ∫⁻_{S∩M} θ dHⁿ, i.e. Hⁿ(S ∩ M) ≤ μ(S).
2. The support spt μ is closed (Measure.isClosed_support), so S₀ := (spt μ)ᶜ is open (IsClosed.isOpen_compl) and therefore Borel (IsOpen.measurableSet).
3. ℝ^P is a second countable, hence hereditarily Lindelöf, space, so the complement of the support is μ-null: μ(S₀) = μ((spt μ)ᶜ) = 0 (MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_compl_support).
4. As sets, M ∖ spt μ = S₀ ∩ M, because x ∈ M ∧ x ∉ spt μ ⇔ x ∈ (spt μ)ᶜ ∧ x ∈ M (ext; simp with and_comm). By steps 1–3, Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ) = Hⁿ(S₀ ∩ M) ≤ μ(S₀) = 0, and a measure value ≤ 0 equals 0 (nonpos_iff_eq_zero). Hence Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ) = 0. ∎

Checked Lean rendering of steps above (compiled with `lake env lean` after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission`, inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` / `namespace Submission` with the contract's opens; `#print axioms` reports only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; it also passes the leaf source-delta rule):
```lean
theorem dgid_carrier_sdiff_measure_support_null : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), μHE[n] (R.carrier \ R.measure.support) = 0 := by
  intro P n U R
  have key : ∀ S : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet S → μHE[n] (S ∩ R.carrier) ≤ R.measure S := by
    intro S hS
    rw [IMRep.measure, withDensity_apply _ hS, Measure.restrict_restrict hS, ← setLIntegral_one]
    refine setLIntegral_mono' (hS.inter R.measurableSet_carrier) fun x hx => ?_
    exact_mod_cast R.mult_pos x hx.2
  have hS : MeasurableSet R.measure.supportᶜ :=
    R.measure.isClosed_support.isOpen_compl.measurableSet
  have h0 : R.measure R.measure.supportᶜ = 0 := Measure.measure_compl_support
  have hset : R.carrier \ R.measure.support = R.measure.supportᶜ ∩ R.carrier := by
    ext x; simp [and_comm]
  rw [hset]
  exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp ((key _ hS).trans h0.le)
```
key_steps: For Borel S: μ_R(S) = ∫⁻_{S∩M} θ dHⁿ (withDensity_apply, Measure.restrict_restrict) ≥ ∫⁻_{S∩M} 1 dHⁿ = Hⁿ(S ∩ M), because θ ≥ 1 on M (R.mult_pos, setLIntegral_mono', setLIntegral_one).
S₀ := (spt μ_R)ᶜ is open, hence Borel (Measure.isClosed_support), and μ_R(S₀) = 0 (Measure.measure_compl_support, ℝ^P second countable).
M ∖ spt μ_R = S₀ ∩ M, so Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ_R) ≤ μ_R(S₀) = 0.
